name: PSX Convenience Store Assets Pack (free low-poly PS1-style props)
summary: Free PS1/PSX-style low-poly convenience store kit for retro, horror and survival games: checkout counter, cash register, barcode scanner, shelves, drink fridge, chest freezer, basket, cart, crates, boxes, displays and canned/boxed products, with separate parts for interactive pieces. FBX, OBJ, GLB and a Unity package with low-res PNG textures.

access.license: PolyNomad pack terms (free & commercial use, modify OK)
access.notes: Usable in free and commercial projects and may be modified; no redistribution or resale of the assets themselves, standalone or in another pack. Terms stated on the itch page.

procedure: Open the itch.io page and click Download Now.
Choose 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads' (or tip).
Download 'PSX Convenience Store – Vol. 01.zip' (5.6 MB) and import FBX/OBJ/GLB or the Unity package.

verdict.why: Clean free PSX prop kit with commercial use and multiple formats, from the creator directly. Small (18 assets) and low traction so far; zip contents not yet verified hands-on.
